title: Synthetic colonoscopy, three polyps

document.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
Colonoscopy report (fictional)
Patient: Riley Synthetic
Date of service: 2026-11-02
Place of service: Ambulatory surgery center
Procedure: Colonoscopy
The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum and the examination was completed.
A 3 mm sessile polyp in the ascending colon was biopsied with cold forceps.
A 9 mm sessile polyp in the sigmoid colon was removed with a cold snare.
A 6 mm sessile polyp in the transverse colon was removed with a cold snare.

modifier_review.text: Separate lesions are documented: 45380 is for the forceps biopsy (cold forceps) of the 3 mm sessile polyp in the ascending colon; 45385 is for the snare removal (cold snare) of the 9 mm sessile polyp in the sigmoid colon and snare removal (cold snare) of the 6 mm sessile polyp in the transverse colon. In an example in CMS's claims manual (Pub. 100-04, chapter 12, section 40.6.C, item 13; Rev. 13753; Issued: 05-07-26), a biopsy of a lesion (45380) and a polyp removed from a different part of the colon (45385) are billed together. Whether an NCCI procedure-to-procedure edit pairs these codes, and which modifier your payer accepts (59 or XS), is not checked here. No modifier is added unless the reviewer chooses one.
